_source: PIVOTSBench paper, Section 3.1 and Appendix B
_note: Five-point bipolar Likert scale. The sign carries meaning: see 'negative_pole' and 'positive_pole'.

dimensions.name: Power
dimensions.definition: Whether the relationship is perceived as equal or unequal in social influence, decision-making agency, and status.

dimensions.name: Involvement
dimensions.definition: Depth of involvement and emotional investment in the relationship.

dimensions.name: Valence
dimensions.definition: Degree of pleasantness and satisfaction versus hostility.

dimensions.name: Objective
dimensions.definition: Whether the relationship is primarily personal or primarily goal-oriented.

dimensions.name: Permanence
dimensions.definition: Expected lifespan of the bond and the kind of commitment it carries.

dimensions.name: Stance
dimensions.definition: Degree of warmth, support, and collaboration, also referred to as affiliation.
